_comment: Model list for the PreFlight Observe node. Keys beginning with '_' are metadata and are ignored by the loader (they are not selectable models). Each entry maps a display name to a Hugging Face repo_id, a default flag (the model pre-selected in the combo), a 'quantized' flag (true only for repos that are ALREADY quantized on disk, e.g. FP8 — the loader forces sdpa and skips bitsandbytes for those), and rough VRAM requirements in GB per precision. Only Instruct variants are listed: 'Thinking' variants emit reasoning text that breaks strict JSON output. Models are downloaded once into ComfyUI/models/LLM/Qwen-VL/<name> and reused across Qwen-VL packs. Add a model by copying an entry; no code change needed. Re-read on every node execution.

_schema.repo_id: string, Hugging Face repo id passed to snapshot_download
_schema.default: bool, optional; the model pre-selected in the node (first one wins)
_schema.quantized: bool, true if the repo ships pre-quantized weights (forces sdpa, no bitsandbytes)
_schema.vram_requirement: object {full, 8bit, 4bit} approximate GB of VRAM per precision
